newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - MCI holds at 35.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - MCI holds at 35.

text.p: U.S. long-distance telephone company MCI Communications Corp maintained its Nasdaq closing price of 35 in the after-hours session, dealers said Friday.
"There's a little bit (of trading)," said one of them.

MCI's stock ended 7-3/8 lower than the previous day's close during the normal session amid a poor forecast for half of 1997 and all of 1998. The company said the cost of moving into the local phone market would hurt profits.
The dealer said trading after the end of the normal session on Friday was otherwise fairly quiet.

Nasdaq halted trading in DuPont Photomasks Inc with a last sale at 53 after the company projected fourth-quarter earnings 12 percent to 16 percent below estimates. First Call's consensus among analysts forecast a profit of $0.63 a share for the quarter against $0.50 for the same period last year.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one had a volume of 6,000 shares compared to 71,300 the previous day. Session two had 150,000 shares against 1.6 million, it said.
